item.title: Blanket Implementations
item.description: If you come from an Object-Oriented Programming background like I do, then Rust's trait architecture can seem a bit confusing at first. Designing code that separates concerns while still sharing code whenever possible is still important in Rust, even without inheritance or polymorphism. One pattern that is useful to know for this purpose is the Blanket Implementation. item.title: LZMA + RLE Compression Library
item.description: View it on Github What it is A library ported from C to Rust that can encode or decode data using either LZMA compression, or a specific combination of LZMA and RLE. This algorithm is specifically tailored around a specific data format used to compress data for Playstation 2 disk images.
